name: Tanjiro Kamado
summary: Koyoharu Gotouge's gentle charcoal seller turned demon hunter, carrying his demon-turned sister Nezuko on his back while he looks for a cure. Demon Slayer began in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 2016.
origin: In Taishō-era Japan, Tanjiro sells charcoal to support his widowed mother and younger siblings. Coming home after a night away, he finds his family slaughtered by the demon lord Muzan Kibutsuji. Only his sister Nezuko survives, and she has been turned into a demon herself, though she still fights her hunger to protect him. A Demon Slayer named Giyu Tomioka spares her and points Tanjiro towards the retired swordsman Sakonji Urokodaki, who trains him in Water Breathing. Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a way to turn Nezuko human again and to stop Muzan for good. Gotouge's editor nudged the early design towards a warmer, brighter lead and suggested the forehead scar to make him stand out.
powers: Hinokami Kagura, his family's dance that echoes the original Sun Breathing
A nose sharp enough to smell emotions and openings
Demon Slayer Mark during peak fights
Endless kindness, even towards dying demons

storyline.title: A family lost
storyline.beat: Tanjiro's family is killed by Muzan, Nezuko becomes a demon, and he trains for two years before passing the brutal Final Selection.

storyline.title: A boy and a box
storyline.beat: He hunts demons with Nezuko asleep in a wooden box on his back and picks up two loud companions, Zenitsu and Inosuke.

storyline.title: Rengoku's last stand
storyline.beat: Aboard a haunted train, Tanjiro fights beside the Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, whose death leaves a lasting mark on him.

storyline.title: Hinokami unleashed
storyline.beat: In the red-light district he and the Sound Hashira take on a pair of Upper Rank demons and he leans hard on his family's fire dance.

storyline.title: The final night
storyline.beat: The whole Corps is dragged into Muzan's shifting fortress for an all-night battle that ends at sunrise, with Nezuko finally human again.

gossip.text: His forehead scar was his editor's idea, partly to give him a look as memorable as Kenshin's cross-shaped scar.
Gotouge's early pitch for the series was a one-shot called Kisatsu no Nagare, which did not get picked up.
His hanafuda earrings were redrawn for the Chinese release because their sun design looked too much like the Rising Sun flag.
Tanjiro was born into a family of swordsmen.
gossip.truth: He was a charcoal seller. His family only passed down a sacred dance, which turns out to hide an ancient sword style.

gossip.text: Natsuki Hanae voices him in Japanese and Zach Aguilar in English.
He won Best Boy at the 2020 Crunchyroll Anime Awards.
The final volume sold about 2.86 million copies in its first week, an Oricon record for any single manga volume.

quiz.q: What did Tanjiro do for a living before becoming a Demon Slayer?
quiz.why: He sold charcoal to support his family.

quiz.q: Which breathing style does Tanjiro learn first?
Which Demon Slayer film became Japan's highest-grossing film ever in 2020?
quiz.why: Mugen Train overtook Spirited Away in December 2020.

theme.tagline: A kind heart, a hard head and a little sister in a box.

timeline.title: Demon Slayer begins
timeline.note: The manga starts in Weekly Shōnen Jump in February 2016.

timeline.title: Ufotable's anime
timeline.note: The TV anime premieres in April 2019, and its lush fight scenes turn the series into a craze.

timeline.title: The manga ends
timeline.note: The final chapter runs in May 2020, after just over four years.

timeline.title: Mugen Train breaks records
timeline.note: Released in October, the film passes Spirited Away in December to become Japan's top-grossing film.

timeline.title: Swordsmith Village
timeline.note: The third season sends Tanjiro to the hidden village of the sword makers.

timeline.title: Hashira Training
timeline.note: A short fourth season shows the Corps getting ready for the last war against Muzan.

timeline.title: Infinity Castle in cinemas
timeline.note: The first film of the Infinity Castle trilogy opens in Japan in July 2025.
